findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "linkedin" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_v1_post_details · Private data: get_v2_profile_contact_info · Public sink: get_v1_post_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_v1_post_details · Private data: get_v2_profile_contact_info · Public sink: get_v1_post_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
